summary: Gives the strict syntax rules for O() and RV() references so renderers can build links: current module options, other role entrypoints, options of other plugins via FQCN#type, options of other roles, and the ignore: prefix for removed options.
questions: How do I link to an option of a different module in my docs?
How do I reference an option from another entrypoint of my role?
How can I mention an option that has been removed without creating a broken link?
What's the syntax for referencing an option in another role?

answer_card.title: Syntax for O() and RV() references
answer_card.answer_md:
- Current module/plugin or role entrypoint: `O(option)`, `O(option=value)`
- Another entrypoint of this role: `O(entrypoint:option)`
- Another plugin/module: `O(plugin.fqcn.name#type:option)` (use `type=module` for modules)
- Another role's entrypoint: `O(role.fqcn.name#role:entrypoint:option)`
- Options that don't exist (e.g. removed): `O(ignore:option)`; `ignore:` isn't shown to readers.

The same forms apply to `RV()` for return values.
